messages:
elaine: quick question: when adding scope inheritance for flags (global -> region -> gateway), how strict should activation semantics be? should child scope inherit latest parent version automatically or require explicit promotion?

noah: I'd prefer explicit promotion by default. automatic inheritance surprises people when parent changes. we can have an opt-in auto-sync boolean.

michael: for safety, auto-sync should only apply to read-only style fields like metadata. for enforcement toggles it's risky.

elaine: console implications: show an inheritance graph and badge for when a child diverges from parent. ideally a diff view that highlights effective values.

noah: also need API to fetch effective config: GET /api/v1/runtime/effective-config?scope=gateway&id=gw-nyc-1&time=now -> returns resolved values and origin path.

michael: add audit trail metadata: origin_version, promoted_by, promotion_ts. and include a field effective_reason when a value came from fallback.

ops-bot: reminder: all promotion actions require approver if scope=region or global and time is between 22:00-06:00 UTC.

elaine: perfect. i'll incorporate in the RFC.
